protocol.description:
This protocol allows compositors and clients to associate ext_foreign_toplevel_pidfd_handle_v1 objects with PIDFDs, file descriptors referring to tasks.
The key words "must", "must not", "required", "shall", "shall not", "should", "should not", "recommended", "may", and "optional" in this document are to be interpreted as described in IETF RFC 2119.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: ext_foreign_toplevel_pidfd_list_v1
interface.description:
This interface describes a global that can act as an extension to a ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1 object.
When this global is bound, it is initially not associated with a ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1. The client must send the set_list request to set the underlying toplevel list.

request.name: destroy
request.description:
If the set_list request was used, this request should only be sent after the client has received the ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1.finished event of the underlying toplevel list.
See ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1.destroy.

request.name: set_list
request.description:
The client can send this request to associate this object with a ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1 object.
This request must not be sent more than once for this object. Otherwise the list_set error is emitted.
Each ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1 can be used at most once as an argument to this request. Otherwise the has_extension error is emitted.
After processing this request, the compositor will start emitting toplevel events.

event.name: toplevel

description.summary: a pidfd handle has been created

event.description:
The compositor sends this event to create a ext_foreign_toplevel_pidfd_handle_v1 extending a ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.
The compositor can send this event at any time, however, each ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 appears at most once in this event.
The ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 argument was created by the underlying list.
The compositor will not send this event after the ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1.finished event of the underlying list; or before the set_list request has been processed.

entry.name: has_extension
entry.summary: set_list was called with a toplevel list that was already used

interface.name: ext_foreign_toplevel_pidfd_handle_v1
interface.description: This object is an extension for a toplevel handle. The compositor uses it to send additional properties for the handle.

event.name: pidfd
event.description:
This event sets the PIDFD of the handle. The PIDFD is double-buffered state. See ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.done.
The file descriptor refers to a PIDFD.

event.name: no_fd
event.description: This event unsets the PIDFD of the handle. The PIDFD is double-buffered state. See ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.done.
